title: Wrong-way vehicle entering service lane
summary: Vehicle heading was opposite the signed service-lane direction for 16 s [SIG-2011]. The edge detector escalated the incident after confirming sustained wrong-way movement across two consecutive framesets [SIG-2013].
sop: Notify road control and request service-lane intervention.
Keep camera R4 pinned until the vehicle exits or turns around.

vlm.description: A vehicle is positioned against the expected service-lane direction with no obvious traffic marshal visible.

second_opinion.question: Could road works explain the direction?
second_opinion.answer: No clear road-work signage or marshal is visible in the snapshot.

heading vector 167 deg opposite lane direction

review.note: Notify road control for service-lane intervention.
